proposedException.name: EXPECTED_CALIBRATION_OVERFLOW_ONLY

the intentional firstLost 4097 is explicitly detected and recorded as INCOMPLETE/UNKNOWN
original calibration raw records are saved and independently readable
calibration stdout/stderr/exit/cleanup/persistence and any other integrity checks satisfy their designated contract
no other unplanned overflow, missing record, error, substitution, or ambiguous generation
separate independent review and explicit owner approval of this exact exception

expectedVersusObserved.preflightTrustAnchor: independent authorized original/registration, not the envelope under audit
preFreeze: registration slot IDs/order/groups and classification rules
source/Git blob/transform and required instrumentation identity
required observation event kinds/phase/order/generation rather than future timestamp or event-byte hash
full expected build manifest and served resource mapping after build, before experimental launch
neverPrecompute: runtime event IDs or hashes of events not yet generated
runtime response bodies not yet served/received
expectedVersusObserved.measurementProof: capture immutable primary bytes at original primary boundary via independent exclusive raw record, then attach observed SHA without replacing raw or upgrading product result
expectedVersusObserved.provenanceAudit: independent reader verifies trusted plan/probe source, raw primary hash/bytes and observed event stream against separately frozen expected rules; generated oracle must never be derived from received suspect envelope
expectedVersusObserved.instrumentI0: retain original primary getAttribute and exclusive save; no audit-only added mark
expectedVersusObserved.instrumentI1: append-only bounded callback/update/commit/generation markers, no extra synchronous DOM reads or awaited probe
expectedVersusObserved.instrumentI2: listed additional target DOM/transition/MutationObserver markers; delivery time is not mutation time
expectedVersusObserved.bodyBinding: server-written bytes distinct from browser-received bytes; no re-fetch substitute for historic response

stopPolicy.conflict: deferred response.body after common followup cannot retrospectively stop earlier commands within the same slot

optionB.name: PROPOSED_STOP_NEXT_SLOTS_AFTER_BODY_DETECTION
atDetection: mark affected slot audit FAIL, preserve product primary PASS/FAIL/NOT_TESTED independently
prevent any later slot from starting
allow already in-flight operations to terminate or be boundedly stopped; never assert retroactive cancellation
stillStopImmediatelyOnDetectable: evidence capacity overflow except separately approved synthetic calibration fixture

bounds.timeoutPolicy: original numeric product and API timeouts unchanged
bounds.deadlineAction: stop future slot starts; record in-flight as STARTED_INTERRUPTED; distinguish process cleanup and incomplete evidence; no automatic resume
bounds.diskPolicy: existing owner-approved new project-specific location; no shared /tmp; original source/records immutable; no unapproved delete/move/overwrite

approve reconciliation/contract change for delayed body and strong immediate stop
